7-Zip 26.05
===========
Unmodified 7z.exe and 7z.dll from the official x64 installer:
https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/tag/26.05
https://www.7-zip.org/

See License.txt (LGPL plus the listed BSD/unRAR terms) and LGPL.txt.
The exact corresponding upstream source is included as 7z2605-src.tar.xz.
manifest.json records the pinned upstream installer digest and the hashes of
all distributed engine/source/license files. The app does not load a tool
from PATH and does not download an archive engine at runtime.
